why: The clamp raised past any real intent, so a long board sentence grows its card again and every card sharing that grid row grows with it. This is the owner-reported defect exactly: swapping Pinwheel for Keystone moved the second row from 122.4px to 140.1px at 1280x800. The rule still LOOKS like a clamp, which is what makes it the plausible edit -- someone widening the copy budget would reach for this number first.
